text:
Alice M: Hey team, escalating a customer hit: JS SDK streaming reconnects very quickly and we see duplicated partial outputs + a missing final frame sometimes.
Ben J: Ugh, reproducible? steps?
Alice M: Yes. Quick repro attached by customer — high-frequency reconnects (client retries every 200ms after disconnect). Using our `EventSource`-style SSE wrapper in the browser.
Caroline P: Any 401s in the logs? token rotation?
Alice M: No 401s. Server logs show: `resume window expired` and then immediate `resume accepted` when connection reopened. We still emit duplicate "delta" chunks.
Theo (oncall): Can you paste the client code?
Alice M: ```js
const es = new EventSource(url);
es.onmessage = (e) => { handleChunk(JSON.parse(e.data)); };
es.onerror = () => { // reconnect logic that re-attaches immediately after 200ms };
```
Ben J: Hmm. Customer uses client-side prefetch: they open a new connection while previous one is draining to reduce latency. That could overlap KV cache windows.
Caroline P: I wonder if our server-side heartbeat offset + prefetch leads to duplicate emit when old connection's final frame arrives right after resume handshake. Essentially two streams both think they're the active writer for a short window.
Support Bot: deploy-bot posted: "runtime/v1.9.4 deployed to prod - 3332109600" :rocket:
Ben J: Interesting — v1.9.4 changed prefetch window from 250ms -> 500ms to reduce cold-starts. Could be regression.
Theo (oncall): Repro plan: simulate rapid reconnects with prefetch enabled, capture server correlation id and seqnums. Need to confirm if duplicates have same seqnum or overlapping seq ranges.
Alice M: Customer provided an example: duplicate deltas share identical `chunk_id` and token ranges. So same content emitted twice.
Caroline P: If chunk_id identical, seems server emitted same chunk on both resume and on final flush. Maybe flush race: when resume accepted we replay cache (prefix) and then old connection flushes remaining output.
Ben J: Workaround for customer: disable prefetch or increase retry backoff >500ms. That avoids overlap. Sent them a patch note.
Alice M: They asked for fast fix — can we hotfix runtime to prevent double-emit when chunk_id already acknowledged?
Eng Runtime: Investigating — quick fix is to de-dupe by chunk_id at router level. Will push a small guard: if chunk_id seen in resume acknowledgment window, drop duplicate emit.
Caroline P: Also add telemetry to detect heartbeat offset >100ms; include a metric.
Theo (oncall): Rolling a staged hotfix to prod-1 now. Patch: runtime 1.9.5 with de-dupe guard.
Support Bot: deploy-bot posted: "runtime/v1.9.5 hotfix rolled to prod-1 - 3332109850" :white_check_mark:
Alice M: Customer tried 1.9.5 on prod-1 and confirms duplicates gone in their test harness. They still see occasional missing final frame when client aborts during reconnect.
Ben J: Missing final frame on abort might be client-side AbortController race. Recommend client ensure `close()`/`drain` completes before immediate reconnect.
Caroline P: Add docs note: when using prefetch, avoid ultra-aggressive reconnect < prefetch window. Also recommend SDK v0.18.2 which exposes `resumeBackoffMs` configurable.
Alice M: I'll update the ticket and patch customer to v0.18.2. Thanks all :tada:
Theo (oncall): Follow-up TODOs: (1) add server dedupe metric, (2) investigate flush ordering to avoid final-frame drop on abort, (3) make prefetch window configurable per-tenant.
Ben J: Filing infra issue for long-term fix.
Alice M: Closing loop with customer now.
